name: B10-0202/2026 (The Left) – Ensuring accountability and justice in response to Russia’s continued attacks against the civilian population in Ukraine
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on ensuring accountability and justice in response to Russia’s continued attacks against the civilian population in Ukraine
part_text:
This resolution is an opinion. It does not change any law. It condemns Russia's attacks on civilians in Ukraine and calls for those responsible to be held accountable. It asks the European Union to support the International Criminal Court, cancel Ukraine's foreign debt, and set up ways to pay compensation to victims. It also says the European Union applies international law unevenly, and asks it to treat Israel as it treats Russia, including ending military cooperation and suspending the EU-Israel Association Agreement.

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament only states its position.
- It targets Russia, Israel, the United States and Iran, and the European Union's own foreign policy.
- Next, the text goes to the European Commission, the Council and Member State governments and parliaments.
